content.text: {"sentences":[{"text":"The most impactful thing I've built is safe retries for checkout at Example Payments.","cites":[{"id":"a-retries","quote":"Cut checkout errors by 30% at Example Payments by adding retries in Go."},{"id":"s-retries","quote":"Making checkout retries safe."}]},{"text":"Checkout calls to the card processor failed a few times an hour and customers saw errors.","cites":[{"id":"s-retries","quote":"Checkout calls to the card processor failed a few times an hour and customers saw errors."}]},{"text":"I owned the checkout service, and I added idempotent retries in Go with a key per payment.","cites":[{"id":"s-retries","quote":"I owned the checkout service."},{"id":"s-retries","quote":"I added idempotent retries in Go with a key per payment."}]},{"text":"Checkout errors dropped by 30% and nobody was charged twice.","cites":[{"id":"s-retries","quote":"Checkout errors dropped by 30% and nobody was charged twice."}]}],"followUps":[]}
